notes.title: 0.3.7 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Quick Fix - Grapple automatically closing on use. 
Fixed - Potential workaround for Out Of Video Memory Crash on machines with older graphics cards ( Please update your drivers if you haven't <3 )

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.6 - Mommy no!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Stormtreaders! 

We've got a light one here with some bug fixes, clarity changes, and adjustments to the way that the Mother works. 

Fixed - Backpacks expending all of their charges at once
Fixed - Dead player names not showing up on the spectator UI
Fixed - Players could spawn ghost objects while using the drone controller. They have been Exorcised.
Fixed - Mother now attempts to find alternate paths to the player but will give up after a time if unable.
Fixed - Rare crash when picking up items has been fixed
Fixed - Players no longer continue running when activating the drone controller.
Fixed - Goblin no longer steals multiple items from incapacitated players. He was being very greedy.
Fixed - Dying while incapacitated would prevent you from controlling your spectator. Now you may observe.
Fixed - Fuel was uncapped, it should now stay inside of the fuel container.

Added - Slot indicators for perks, to make it more clear that 4 perks can be equipped at once

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.5
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011568/7661d395e7597687443decb736bde8006c1bcef6.png

First of all, we at Naughty Clogs want to thank each and every one of you who've joined us Beyond the Stormwall. It's been incredible to see you all having such a good time in our world and we can't wait to bring you more. We've been watching your streams, reading your feedback, and taking LOTS of notes. 

There's a lot of stuff on our radar now and we're working through that list as quickly as possible. As a really tiny team, some of these will take a bit of time.   Right now we're making sure we focus on some of the biggest issues to guarantee you all can continue to have a good time. 

We've noticed a few people struggling with a GPU crash that we're trying to drill down into.

If you are getting an Out of Video Memory crash:
We're trying to see if there's anything we can do on our end, but if you're running into this seemingly random crash, please make sure that your video card drivers are up to date.  We know some things have changed in the way rendering is optimized in the newer versions of Unreal Engine and these newer driver updates are a potential quick fix. 


 The heartiest of Thank Yous
Once again, from the bottom of our hearts: Thank you so much for joining us on this adventure. It's been a wild ride getting Skyward Extraction out the door, but we're having an incredible time and your love and feedback has been pivotal in that process. 

Keep those stories and videos coming, we really do watch every single one of them. 



 Changelog:
Hotfix  - Fixed rare crash when trying to interact with an object that someone else is also trying to interact with. 

Hotfix - The Drone now respects your controller settings, so it shouldn't be spinning around at mach 5 anymore.  Even you folks that love inverted mouse look, we've got you covered too.

Hotfix -  Fixed The *E to Control* dialogue should no longer show up across the map when you're flying the drone.

Hotfix - Fixed issue where backpacks would disappear when using the drone controller.

notes.title: Minor Hotfix 6/18/24
notes.notes:
We've implemented a new voice chat system that should be more stable for everyone. 
This allows us to implement a new push to talk feature with V being the default push to talk hotkey. 
Currently we don't have the ability to rebind keys at the moment, but it's definitely on the roadmap. 

We've also addressed a few other issues that have popped up from the feedback you've given us so far. 



Fixes:
*Melvin no longer steals the items You've purchased. He will now place them on the ground in front of the counter.

*Players should no longer fall through the ship when interacting with the map while it is moving.

*The Drone Control Terminal now correctly shows when the drone pack is deployed correctly, the light should turn green on the ship when the drone is available to control. 

*Standing on the drone backpack will no longer prevent the drone from spawning ( leading to the drone user getting completely ruined)
